label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: support@clockpoint.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: kevin.mutua@tausifreight.example
Subject: Re: [CP-48213] Overtime coding issue on night shifts

Dear Faith,

Thank you for picking this up. Here are the details you asked for, in the same order.

1. Terminals and firmware: four BX-300 terminals at our Embakasi depot. They auto-updated from firmware 4.1.8 to 4.2.1 on the night of 27 October. Our two terminals at Mombasa Road were offline that week, so they are still on 4.1.8, and their exports are fine.

2. Shift template: NIGHT-8, 22:00 to 06:00.

3. Example: employee T-0417 clocked in at 21:54 on 30 October and out at 06:07 on 31 October. The export shows 2.1 hrs REG on 30 October and 6.1 hrs OT15 on 31 October. We expected 8.0 hrs REG and 0.2 hrs OT15. Our payroll rounds to the nearest tenth of an hour, so the 8 h 13 min total is 8.2 hrs, and only the 13 minutes outside the scheduled shift should be overtime.

4. Export profile: Payroll CSV v2.

5. First noticed: 5 November, while reviewing the draft October overtime. The affected shifts start from about 28 October, right after the update.

In short, any shift that crosses midnight is being split into two lines, and the after-midnight line is coded OT15 instead of REG. It affects 38 staff on nights at Embakasi. The 4.2.1 release notes promised improved midnight rollover handling for shifts that span two calendar days, and it has done the exact opposite.

I also have one direct question. Brian Ochieng in our IT team can roll the four Embakasi terminals back to 4.1.8. Is that safe to do, and would we lose any punch data stored on the terminals? We are holding off until you confirm.

On timing, our November payroll inputs close on Friday 20 November, so we need a fix or a clear workaround before then. We corrected October by hand from the raw punches, but we cannot do that every month.

I have copied Kevin Mutua, our payroll officer. He will test whatever you suggest, so please keep him on the thread.

Kind regards,
Njeri Mwangi
HR Manager, Tausi Freight
